title: Incident Replay Manifest
description: Formalizes what the Repair stage's STEP 3 already does ad hoc: check out a bad SHA, apply the regression test the repair introduced, prove it fails, then prove it passes at the fixed SHA. See replay/README.md.

replay_id.description: Kebab-case, unique. Matches the manifest and proof file basenames.

incident_id.description: Repo-relative path to the memory/incidents/**/INC-*.md this replay backfills.

feature_id.description: memory/registry.yml feature key this incident belongs to.

bad_version.description: Commit SHA before the repair. The replay must reproduce the failure here.

fixed_version.description: Commit SHA that repaired the incident. The replay must pass here.

target.description: Repo-relative path the runner overlays this file onto in the worktree, at both bad_version and fixed_version.

test_command.description: Shell command run from the worktree root, e.g. './node_modules/.bin/vitest run <path>'. Must never invoke build, deploy, or a write path.

expected_failure_mode.description: Why bad_version is expected to fail, recorded so a run.mjs pass/fail is checked against an explanation, not just an exit code. 'missing-export' is common in this repo: STEP 3 writes the test against symbols the repair itself introduces.

reviewed.description: A manifest can only land after an explicit sanitization review. No assumed-safe default.
